texts.title: Introduce me to partners
texts.body:
By ticking the box you ask ApprovalReady to introduce you to up to the number of partners you chose, in the kinds of work you ticked.

What partners see first: the kind of work, your suburb, council area, state and postcode, when you want to start, the approvals our assessment found and the short description you wrote. Not your name or contact details.

What a partner gets when they accept: only the contact details you ticked (your name, email, phone or site address). Each partner who accepts can contact you about this request. No more partners than the number you chose can accept.

How partners are chosen: a partner must be checked by us, approved for this kind of work (with a current licence where one is needed) and work in your area. Among those, we rank on how close they work to you, how specialised they are, whether their insurance is checked, how quickly they usually reply and how busy they are. Partners do not pay to rank higher. If that ever changes, the partner will be marked "Sponsored".

Money: partners may pay ApprovalReady a subscription and a fee when they accept a request. You pay ApprovalReady nothing for introductions. A partner's quote and work are between you and them: we don't recommend, guarantee or supervise any partner.

Withdrawing: you can withdraw this request at any time from your project. Partners who have not accepted it yet will no longer see it. Partners who already accepted keep the details you shared; ask them directly if you want them deleted.

The request ends when enough partners have accepted it, or after 14 days.
